TCP::unused_port
Description
Returns an unused TCP port for the specified IP tuple, using the value
of
<hint_port>
as a starting point if it is supplied. If no
appropriate unused local port could be found, 0 is returned.
Syntax
TCP
::
unused_port
<
remote_addr
>
<
remote_port
>
<
local_addr
>
[
<
hint_port
>
]
TCP::unused_port
Returns an unused TCP port for the specified IP tuple, using the value
of
<hint_port>
as a starting point if it is supplied. If no
appropriate unused local port could be found, 0 is returned.
Examples
rule
rule_unused_port1
{
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
log
local0.
[
TCP
::
unused_port
192.168
.1.124
80
192.168
.1.146
]
}
}
# 192.168.1.124:80 is a pool member
# 192.168.1.146 is a self ip
# The result on /var/log/ltm is like this
# Aug 22 09:47:44 local/tmm info tmm[27004]: Rule rule_unused_port1 <HTTP_REQUEST>: 26479
